_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 7: beam and shot helpers, reset and main loop ($FE22-$FFE3). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: Beam style records: 9 x [metasprite][`$0638`][half-width]
regions.description: `00 40 03 | 1A 60 08 | 17 F0 18 | 00 20 02 | 00 40 02 | 00 60 02 | 1A F0 08 | 00 F0 08 | 00 10 08`, read at `$FE22 + 3n` (n = 0 Hyper Laser level 1, 1 level 2, 2 level 3; 3, 4, 5 Optomon's three beams; 6 Clawbot; 7 Eyegore; 8 the bank 6 `$6A`/`$69` beams): the beam's picture, its `$0638` (a length parameter) and its half-width in pixels. The earlier generated cards `$FE22`, `$FE23` and `$FE24` were this table's columns.

regions.name: BEAM AND SHOT HELPERS (bank 7 `$FE3D-$FEDD`): make a beam piece (`$FE3D`, slot `$C13E`)
regions.description: `LDA #$22 / JSR $FA4B`: a type-`$22` child of object X in slot Y. It gets `$06C8,Y` := `$17`, `$05D8,Y` := `$16` (the two halves of the style-record pointer the caller built from `$FE22`), **`$0668,Y` := X (its parent slot) and `$0680,Y` := the parent's type** - the two fields the beam machine `$FB76` reads.

regions.name: BEAM AND SHOT HELPERS (bank 7 `$FE3D-$FEDD`): store the beam end (`$FE57`, slot `$C141`)
BEAM AND SHOT HELPERS (bank 7 `$FE3D-$FEDD`): re-aim countdown (`$FE63`, slot `$C144`)
regions.description: `$0680,X` = the number of re-aims left (0 returns with carry clear), `$0668,X` the countdown: at 0 it is reloaded from A, the object aims at the player (`$F85D`) and `$0680` is decremented; carry set means it just re-aimed.

regions.name: BEAM AND SHOT HELPERS (bank 7 `$FE3D-$FEDD`): zero the velocity (`$FE79`, slot `$C147`)
regions.description: `$05C0`, `$05D8`, `$05F0`, `$0608` := 0 (the y and x speeds and their fractions).

regions.name: BEAM AND SHOT HELPERS (bank 7 `$FE3D-$FEDD`): spend the shot (`$FECC`, slot `$C168`)
regions.description: Sound `$21`; the shot in slot Y loses `$14` + 1 (the carry is clear after the sound call) = **21 hit points** (floor 0) and the call returns. Used where a part cannot be hurt: the spore `$72`, It's arms.

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): reset (`$FEDE`, slot `$C000`, the RESET vector)
regions.description: `SEI / CLD`, the stack `$FF`.

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): PPU off
regions.description: PPUCTRL := `$30`.

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): wait for three vblanks
regions.description: `LDX #3`; three times: poll PPUSTATUS bit 7 (the PPU needs its warm-up).

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): APU
regions.description: `$4015` := `$0F` (four channels on, DMC off), `$4017` := `$C0` (no frame IRQ).

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): clear the RAM
regions.description: `$0000-$07FF` := 0 (X from 0 to 255 and all eight pages).

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): PPU set-up
regions.description: `$FF` := `$30` through `$D4E7` (PPUCTRL: 8 x 16 sprites, background from table 1, NMI off) and `$FE` := 6 through `$D4CF` (PPUMASK: left column shown, rendering off).

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): check the mapper
regions.description: Y from 6 down to 0: switch to bank Y and compare `$BFFF` with Y; a match goes on. **A mismatch loads a colour from `$FF3A,Y` into the backdrop `$0180`, forces the palette out (`$DED2`) and spins at `JMP $FF37` for ever** - the colour says which bank failed.

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): next bank
regions.description: `DEY / BPL $FF25`.

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): bank 6 reset
regions.description: Bank 6 (`$D762`), `JSR $800F` (bank 6 reset init `$8015`: queue, sound init, DMC timer, score, zero page).

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): the title (`$FF4A`, slot `$C14D`)
regions.description: Stack reset; bank 0 (`$D714`), `JSR $800C` (bank 0 `$8332`: the sound-test check and the title screen and its menu); `$2F` zero goes on to `$FF5D`, else (the title's second item) bank 3 (`$D73B`) `JSR $800C`: the password screen, and then on.

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): start the game (`$FF5D`, slot `$C150`)
regions.description: Stack reset, sound `$1F` (stop the music), the fade out (`$EDD1`), rendering off (`$D4C1`), bank 0 `JSR $8003` (the game set-up `$805B`), `JSR $E110` (the HUD's score row), bank 6, `JSR $CDA2` (the sprite allocator's start).

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): the main loop
regions.description: `JSR $E655` (the stage step), `LDY #1 / JSR $FF8B` (one game-loop pass), `JSR $D76F` with `03 0E 80` (bank 3 `$800F`: the boss and miniboss routine `$917F`), and round again.

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): loop jump
regions.description: `JMP $FF7A`.

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): game-loop passes (`$FF8B`, slot `$C024`)
regions.description: X and Y saved. Y times: **the frame sync (`$DA9A`), the pads and pause (`$F493`), `JSR $D76F` with `06 FF 7F` (bank 6 `$8000`, the object loop),**

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): game-loop passes, the rest
regions.description: the HUD (`$E0F9`) and the decompressor's share (`$DB52`); Y counts down; X and Y restored; `RTS`.

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): wait Y frames (`$FFD1`, slot `$C021`)
regions.description: `$2B` := 0 and the frame sync (`$DA9A`) Y times.

regions.name: RESET AND MAIN LOOP (bank 7 `$FEDE-$FFDF`): area music (`$FFDC`, slot `$C15F`)
regions.description: Plays the song `$EF16[$50]` (the labyrinth's music by area).
